SideSpeed 0.7.0 adds a simpler Home screen, My Apps, and update notices for your sideloaded apps.

## What's new
- **Home screen.** SideSpeed opens on four big buttons, each with a status line: **My Apps**, **Auto-optimize**, **Tools** and **About**. Back returns you to the button you came from.
- **My Apps.** Your apps, with **All** and **Sideloaded** filters. Each app has a checkbox on the right: tick it and SideSpeed recompiles that app after every update. Apps your Auto-optimize setting already covers show a locked tick. Opening an app and pressing Back returns you to the same row.
- **Auto-optimize** has its own screen: pick Selected apps, Sideloaded only or All apps, and see the History.
- **Compile mode moved.** Choose speed or speed-profile on the app's compile screen. Speed is the default; an app keeps the mode it was last compiled with.
- **Updates for sideloaded apps.** When a newer version of a sideloaded app is out, its row in My Apps shows **Update:** and the new version, the Home screen counts the updates, and the app's screen shows where to get it as a QR code and a short link. SideSpeed checks a list on sidespeed.app once a day; your app list never leaves the TV. SideSpeed only tells you; it doesn't install other apps. Betas and test builds never show an update.
- **Turn off extras suggests a list.** When no list matches your TV exactly but one names your TV's model and codename, SideSpeed asks: **Use this list** or **Not my TV**. Nothing is turned off until you pick apps, and SideSpeed remembers your answer.

**Updating:** press **Update now** on the update notice, or **About → Check for updates**. From 0.4.0 or earlier, update once with Downloader (code **3503400**).

Updating stops the helper, as before. On Google TV, open SideSpeed to start it again; on Fire TV, the Companion starts it.

**Companion for Android:** the app no longer draws under the status bar and gesture bar on newer phones.

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.7.0.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV with Fire OS) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.7.0.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.7.0-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.7.0-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.7.0-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |
